title: Benchy boats
description: All Minecraft boats reworked into clean, detailed 3D models while keeping the original vanilla look.
body:
All Minecraft boats reimagined as 3D-printed Benchy models!


Do you love 3D printing? Do you love Minecraft?

Then this pack combines both worlds into one fun addon!


This resource pack replaces every Minecraft boat with a fully redesigned 3D Benchy-style boat, inspired by the iconic calibration prints used on Bambu Lab and other 3D printers.


🛶 Features



✔ All boat types replaced with detailed 3D models

✔ Faithful Benchy proportions (cabin, chimney, porthole, hull shape)

✔ Works in survival and multiplayer

✔ Lightweight and compatible with OptiFine


🎨 Design


The models are made to look like classic 3D-printer Benchys, with blocky Minecraft charm.

Perfect for builders, boat lovers, or 3D-printing fans!


🔧 Compatibility


This pack works with:
Minecraft 1.20+
OptiFine/EMF (required)
All shaderpacks
Multiplayer servers
Other resourcepacks (as long as they don’t change boat models)



📦 Installation
Download the ZIP
Install OptiFine or EMF
Put it into:
Minecraft → Options → Resource Packs → Open Pack Folder
Enable the pack
Enjoy your new 3D Benchy boats!


❤️ Support


If you enjoy the pack, please leave a like ★

It helps a lot and motivates more updates (like rafts, chests, or color variations).
